import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u029/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f77f75e9.py')

# template 2 marker coords offsets r3c9 r4c8 r5c7 r6c6 r7c5,c7
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(0,0),(1,-1),(2,-2),(3,-3),(4,-4),(4,-2)]
    # Find translated stencil occurrences among background cells, ignoring marker cells.
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Object is a stamp; apply it wherever all stencil cells are background zeros.
    for dr in range(H):
      for dc in range(W):
        cells=[(dr+r,dc+c) for r,c in pts]
        if all(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W and grid[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells):
          for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=2
    return g
'''
p.write_text(code)
print('written')
